community_auth_endpoint.status: reference configuration; set public host through account service-discovery integration

community_secure_endpoint.status: reference configuration; secure station URL is returned by the community NEX authentication service

service_discovery.client_certificate: The documented Wii U account server requires the common client certificate.
service_discovery.status: The route and request shape are documented. This repo does not currently implement or control the account server endpoint.
expected_flow: Wii U requests a NEX token for game_server_id 1012F100 from the account/service-discovery endpoint.
That response supplies the public host and UDP port for this project's NEX authentication server, plus the PID and credentials.
The NEX authentication server issues/validates its ticket and advertises the secure server host/port.
The Wii U connects to the secure server for game data, rankings, and matchmaking.

title_ids.note: Published sources differ on the complete regional/title-ID set. Keep all observed values as candidates until verified against installed title metadata or real request headers.

historical_nintendo_endpoint.status: Historical endpoint data only; do not use as the community server address. Nintendo discontinued Wii U online play and online communication services on 2024-04-08.

pretendo_sssl.role: DNS resolver / SSSL entry point, not the community NEX game server

wiilink.role: DNS resolver, not the community NEX game server

dns_resolvers.constraint: This repo cannot change either provider's public DNS records. The Wii U must receive a service-discovery response that points game_server_id 1012F100 at the community authentication endpoint. DNS settings alone do not accomplish that.

evidence.claim: Wii U game-server locations come from the account server route /provider/nex_token/@me.
